stations.title: Ailsa
stations.note: The radio desk, on a busy night.

stations.title: The desk
stations.text: One long if and elif, names typed by hand

stations.title: Bravo
stations.note: On the hill above the ford.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa wants every message to reach the team it is meant for.
Today one long if and elif sorts the calls, and a call sign typed by hand goes wrong.
You write handlers the desk can pass around, and a pager for every team.
Now each call goes to its own handler, and Bravo's pager always says Bravo.
Every team hears its own call sign, and Ailsa never types a name by hand again.
